items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-07-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Except Stewart wasn't in the union.

ctx.x: I suspect that sometimes some of these groups played concerts and parks and stuff sponsored by the Musicians Union or something.

Yeah. Except Stewart wasn't in the union. Oh, that's a good reason. Yeah, and maybe it's why he got the job too. It may have been some sort of benefit or, but I don't, it was one of those things which I can't remember any reason for. I don't remember that being a dance or that he was advertising anything. Did you ever go on an advertising truck? No, I never did.

I've seen them and heard them of course, but I've never been on one. Sounds like it'd be fun, but I guess it would depend on where you sat. Yeah. You know, I've always liked my music loud, but I think sitting with my head in front of the trumpet or trombone might be a little bit wearing after a bit.
